# dsh-java-plugins — Plugin collection for DSH Java

> Java native plugins for [dsh-java](https://github.com/linlannet/dsh-java): MySQL, OceanBase,
> Dameng and Mall plugins. Defines the plugin development contract and reference implementations.

Included plugins:
- dsh-java-mysql       MySQL datasource plugin
- dsh-java-oceanbase   OceanBase datasource plugin
- dsh-java-dameng      Dameng datasource plugin
- dsh-java-mall        Virtual mall business plugin

Each plugin ships:
- `<name>-plugin`  thin JAR with `META-INF/plugin.yaml` + entry class (installed into Harness)
- `<name>-app`     runnable Spring Boot app (ports 8091-8094)

Tech stack: Java 17, Spring Boot 3.5.16, Maven
Version: 0.2.2
Repository: https://github.com/linlannet/dsh-java-plugins
Related: dsh-java, dsh-java-desktop, dsh-java-mobile, dsh-java-release

Build: `mvn clean package -DskipTests`
Test:  `mvn test`
Install: copy `*-plugin/target/*-plugin-<version>.jar` into dsh-java `plugins/install-root`

Docs:
- README.md / README.en.md
- dsh-java/docs/md/java-plugin-development.md
